status: draft - pilot only; nothing is preregistered (null = to be decided by the pilot/budget)

contrast.primary: S8 (pinned compiler) vs S1 (cap 1), same length, same input, same model file
contrast.effect: a = log T_S8 - log T_S1 per block (positive: original policy slower)
contrast.auxiliary: D8/D1 (static vs dynamic L): not built in this run
negative_controls: lengths with u(L)=1 (S8 and S1 identical)
contrast.aa_control: byte-identical copy of the S8 artifact as a third arm

model.note: re-export of the bertsquad-12 weights with a variable sequence axis; not the Zoo file

lengths.rule: lower median of each ir_structure class (sig-v3 census) + {41,256}, timing independent

inputs.controlled: anchor feature 1656 (natural length 41), right-padded to L
inputs.natural: first feature by (qas_id, window_index) among features of natural length L

measurement.process_statistic: arithmetic mean of iterations after warmup (primary); median and min secondary
measurement.timing_boundary: perf_counter_ns around session.run(inputs), outputs kept alive to next call
measurement.randomization: length order, and arm x process order within each block, seeded

inference.unit: block within one VM allocation; allocation means when >= 2 allocations
inference.alpha_source: researcher's error-control choice (plan §11.3), not a law
inference.multiplicity: Holm over the fixed family of confirmed contrasts
inference.direction: fixed in discovery, one-sided in confirmation

correctness.intervention_gate: S8 and S1 outputs bitwise identical (data movement only)
correctness.vs_reference: ORT: reported descriptively; tolerance not set (no post-hoc tolerance)
correctness.semantic_gate: final answer identical to ORT on every feature (researcher's choice, plan §11.5)
